Name: RKS System
Effect: Change the Pokémon's Type to match the Disc on its Held Item slot. (i.e. Electric Disc makes this Pokémon become an Electric Type). Unique Ability.
Description: The Pokémon's physiology morphs according to the data disc inserted in its RKS-drive. There are 17 discs, one for each Type. (No disc is Normal Type).
